description:
Streaming LLM completion (SSE). Yields StreamChunk frames as data: <json>

; closes with data: [DONE]

. Persists ai_gateway.completion on stream close. VA·E5 (TK-4493): with a real adapter the provider streams deltas; the final chunk carries tool_calls assembled from argument fragments and usage {tokens_in, tokens_out, provider_cost} from the provider (stream_options.include_usage), and the completion row stores that usage instead of an approximation (f618fd2e-e581-4533-a68d-42882358d3b9#AC3). Works against any configured OpenAI-compatible base URL (f618fd2e-e581-4533-a68d-42882358d3b9#AC2). context.tenant_id must be the caller tenant.
skipReason: Response is a text/event-stream (SSE) produced by a live third-party model adapter (real Anthropic/OpenAI stream). The JSON-only API runner cannot consume SSE frames nor supply a real provider adapter, so this is exercised by a specialised streaming integration client. Chain is wired for that harness.

testCases.name: SSE stream produces chunks and final completion row

errorCases.when: the body is absent, or either the request or the context object is missing
request is present but request.model or request.prompt is missing or empty

errorCases.message: context.agent_id, context.run_id, and context.trace_id are required
errorCases.when: context is present but any of agent_id, run_id or trace_id is missing or empty

the generator throws AFTER the SSE headers have been flushed (provider unavailable, no matching route, kill-switch tripped, provider mid-stream failure). The HTTP status is already committed as 200, so the failure arrives as an SSE error frame followed by stream close — it can never be a 4xx/5xx status, which is the key difference from /complete

errorCases.message: context.tenant_id does not match the authenticated tenant
errorCases.when: context.tenant_id names a tenant other than the JWT tenant (it selects whose BYOK key is used); an absent tenant_id is filled from the JWT
no Authorization header, or it is not of the form 'Bearer <jwt>' (requireAuth preHandler)
the bearer JWT fails verifyJwt — bad signature, wrong JWT_SECRET, or exp already elapsed (requireAuth preHandler)
